_comment: Copy this file to deploy.config.json (gitignored) and fill in your values. Command-line flags (--sub/--rg/--agent/--tenant) and environment variables (SRE_SUB/SRE_RG/SRE_AGENT/SRE_TENANT) override these. Keys starting with '_' are documentation only and are ignored by the tool.

_fields.subscription: Azure subscription ID (GUID) that contains the SRE Agent resource.
_fields.resourceGroup: Name of the resource group holding the Microsoft.App/agents resource.
_fields.agent: Name of the Azure SRE Agent resource to deploy skills into.
_fields.tenant: Entra ID tenant ID (GUID) that owns the subscription; used so `az` authenticates against the right tenant (az login --tenant <tenant>).
